Ottawa pivots toward tactical defense capabilities and northern sovereignty. 🇨🇦

### Aerospace & Defence
National procurement initiatives advance through the Polar Helicopter Project closing December 31, 2026, alongside ongoing national solicitations for the Commercial Satellite Imagery (CSI) and Commercial Space Situational Awareness Observations RFIs closing March 31, 2027. Prime contractors must align engineering capabilities with federal payload specifications and rigorous northern operating requirements to secure supply chain positioning. Aerospace suppliers should form strategic consortiums to bid on upcoming Department of National Defence surveillance contracts.

### Border Security & Trade Compliance
The Canada Border Services Agency is adjusting operating schedules at nine land ports of entry in British Columbia to align with year-round time changes starting November 1, 2026, while concurrently executing key firearm-smuggling arrests that underscore heightened interdiction scrutiny. Supply chain operators moving freight through Aldergrove, Carson, Cascade, Chopaka, Fraser, Midway, Nelway, Pleasant Camp, and Waneta must map commercial clearance windows against revised terminal hours to prevent delivery delays. Advisory practices can package schedule-audit and supply chain security engagements for logistics operators to optimize pre-arrival electronic data interchange filings.

### Federal Tax & Regulatory Enforcement
Federal authorities issued the Bedford Sherrard Remission Order under the Financial Administration Act to rectify administrative tax misguidance, while an Order in Council brings key provisions of the Contraventions Act into force on November 1, 2026, to streamline federal ticketing. Entities facing complex tax classifications or operating under the Health of Animals Act and Plant Protection Act must maintain meticulous correspondence logs and update internal standard operating procedures. Specialized trade counsel should package tax remission application services and conduct regulatory exposure audits for corporate clients.

### Public Safety & Professional Services
The Correctional Service of Canada has issued a competitive solicitation for a cybercrime and online offending training program for over 2,000 parole officers nationally, while the Western Region Indigenous Professional Design Services RFI remains open for multiple provinces until March 31, 2027. Bidders must integrate specialized digital investigation modules covering dark web activities into scalable instructional design frameworks to meet federal delivery timelines. EdTech providers and professional design firms should bundle asynchronous learning development or architectural services to bid on federal supply arrangements.
